command: set -euo pipefail; EXPECTED=19999bde451f068ee503d4b7c9a0a91712709c2a; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; IDF_EXPORT=''; for candidate in "${IDF_EXPORT_SH:-}" "${HOME}/esp/esp-idf/export.sh" "${HOME}/esp-idf/export.sh"; do if [[ -n "$candidate" && -f "$candidate" ]]; then IDF_EXPORT="$candidate"; break; fi; done; test -n "$IDF_EXPORT"; IDF_ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "$IDF_EXPORT")" && pwd)"; test -d "$IDF_ROOT/.git"; echo "IDF_ROOT=$IDF_ROOT"; git -C "$IDF_ROOT" remote get-url origin; test -z "$(git -C "$IDF_ROOT" status --porcelain --untracked-files=normal)"; git -C "$IDF_ROOT" fetch --tags origin; git -C "$IDF_ROOT" rev-parse 'refs/tags/v5.5.4^{commit}'; git -C "$IDF_ROOT" switch --detach v5.5.4; git -C "$IDF_ROOT" submodule sync --recursive; git -C "$IDF_ROOT" submodule update --init --recursive; test "$(git -C "$IDF_ROOT" describe --tags --exact-match HEAD)" = 'v5.5.4'; test -z "$(git -C "$IDF_ROOT" status --porcelain --untracked-files=normal)"; CLEAN_PATH='/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin'; env -u VIRTUAL_ENV -u CONDA_PREFIX -u PYTHONHOME PATH="$CLEAN_PATH" bash "$IDF_ROOT/install.sh" esp32s3; unset VIRTUAL_ENV CONDA_PREFIX PYTHONHOME || true; export PATH="$CLEAN_PATH"; source "$IDF_EXPORT"; idf.py --version | tee /tmp/idf-version-v554.txt; grep -Eq 'ESP-IDF v5\.5\.4($|[- ])' /tmp/idf-version-v554.txt; printf 'IDF_COMMIT=%s\n' "$(git -C "$IDF_ROOT" rev-parse HEAD)"
